# Corporate Cattle Merit (賽博社畜功德 / サイバー社畜功徳)

> A quiet, fully offline desktop companion. Every keystroke and click quietly
> accrues a little "merit". Buy the client once for US$0.80, add appearances at
> US$0.20 each (with the client, or 4 at a time), or take the US$5.88 Complete pack
> with every current and future appearance.

## What it is

- Product name: Corporate Cattle Merit (Chinese: 賽博社畜功德 / Japanese: サイバー社畜功徳)
- Category: desktop utility / focus-and-encouragement companion
- It counts how many key presses and clicks happen and turns that count into "merit".
- It never reads what you type, your cursor position, window titles, or clipboard.
- It works fully offline. There is no account, no login, no activation, and no telemetry.
- All counts, settings and history stay on your own computer; nothing is uploaded.

## Pricing (USD)

- Client 9.6: US$0.80, one-time. Includes every core feature (merit calendar,
  work progress, merit curve, cultivation rank, multilingual UI) and the base woodfish.
- Appearances: US$0.20 each. Bought together with the client, or from 4 at a time
  (4 = US$0.80). A single appearance is not sold on its own.
- Complete pack: US$5.88, one-time. Client 9.6, every current appearance, one
  exclusive VIP appearance and all future appearances.
- There is no subscription. Payments are processed by Paddle.com, the Merchant of Record.

## System requirements

- Windows 10 or Windows 11
- macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel)

## Key FAQ facts

- Does it read what I type? No. It only counts that a key press or click happened.
- Does it need an account or internet? No. It runs fully offline, with no login or telemetry.
- Where is my data stored? Only on your own computer. Nothing is uploaded.
- What do I get? Client 9.6 is US$0.80; appearances are US$0.20 each (with the client
  or 4 at a time); the Complete pack is US$5.88 with the client, all current appearances,
  one VIP appearance and all future appearances.
- How do I receive a purchase? After payment we email the download link for Windows or
  macOS together with your appearance files; keep the email to re-download.
- Can I get a refund? This is digital content delivered instantly, so there is no refund
  for a change of mind; if a download or import fails or you were charged twice, contact
  support within 30 days and it will be fixed or refunded.
